title: Rebind IFX as a consumer of standalone V4 Guards 1.1.5
goal: Make IFX consume V4 Guards 1.1.5 from von12549/Guard through a successor IFX bundle, human review, composition, parity and P10.3 successor rehearsal, move IFX-owned adoption records to docs/guards/v4-adoption, and record the handoff decision without removing docs/guards/v4.
acceptanceCriteria: The 1.1.5 archive, install receipt and package hash match the published Guard release identities.
Bundle 0.4.3 differs from 0.4.2 only in the declared manifest, Profile version and authority-map base identity, and C6c Windows certification and controls pass.
Explicit human acceptance binds the exact 0.4.3 review packet and a production review bound to the 1.1.5 archive.
The composed 1.1.5 + 0.4.3 installation verifies, the clean Pre passes and the deliberate violation blocks.
Parity replays 52 of 52 cases with zero gaps, the same visible strengthenings and no semantic drift from the certified 1.1.4 captures.
The P10.3 successor rehearsal passes with negative controls for wrong repository, missing asset, hash drift, missing bundle, source-path fallback, self-judgment and premature cleanup.
The receipt sets standaloneSourceAccepted and ifxConsumerRebound true while cleanup, activation, P10.GATE and V3 retirement stay false.
V3 contexts, V3/V3_ifx source, IFX workflows and rulesets are unchanged.
risks: The accepted 1.1.4 scripts pin version literals and could be edited instead of succeeded.
Expiring C6 evidence locks could be extended instead of regenerated.
A tag-only pin would trust a mutable GitHub release.
The IFX workflow specimen could fall back to the current repository or to docs/guards/v4.
A consumer rebinding could be misrepresented as cleanup, activation or P10.GATE.
decisions: Build successor bundle 0.4.3 for base 1.1.5 at the unchanged Target commit instead of editing the accepted 0.4.2 tuple.
Require a new explicit human review because the production review binds the base archive.
Pin both the Guard release tag and the archive SHA-256, and fetch only from von12549/Guard.
Keep docs/guards/v4 in place as a frozen non-canonical duplicate until T8.
Defer the installed Web UI hands-on record to the P10.GATE successor.
